import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    mod = 1000000007
    u = [0] * p
    ans = 1
    start = 0 if k == 1 else 1
    for i in range(start, p):
        if not u[i]:
            v = i
            while not u[v]:
                u[v] = 1
                v = (k * v) % p
            ans = (ans * p) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
